messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: GPU autoscale anomalies detected in us-west-2 - HPA metrics pipeline blackout. Root: prometheus scrape failures -> adapter backlog. Paging oncall.
oncall-alex: seeing it, joining. can folks react with roles? I can take triage for first 15m.
sre-maya: on it. initial check: kubectl shows HPA for inference-gpu has stable metrics=0 for 4m even though queue size rising.
ml-raj: customers report increased inference latency and 429/503s on hosted endpoint r4-prod, queue length +230%.
infra-bot: alert: prometheus-scraper(us-west-2) status=DEGRADED; last successful scrape 2026-03-15T02:04:12Z.
eng-lee: quick blurb: autoscaler relies on custom metric gateway (metrics-adapter) -> if adapter can't post to custom-metrics API, HPAs see stale values and don't scale.
oncall-alex: can someone paste kubectl output? trying:

```
$ kubectl get hpa -n inference inference-gpu
NAME            REFERENCE               TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
inference-gpu   Deployment/inference    0%/80%    2         32        2          3h
```

oncall-alex: replicas stuck at 2, queue metric shows 0 in HPA targets.
sre-maya: running prom query to check scrape errors:

```
rate(prometheus_http_requests_total{job="scraper",status="5xx"}[5m])
```

sre-maya: reply: elevated 5xx from scraper -> 0.8rps, adapter queue depth increasing.
ml-raj: seeing adapter logs with repeated 504 from the custom metrics API: "Post /apis/custom.metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1: upstream timeout"
infra-bot: metrics-adapter pod(s): metrics-adapter-0 crashloop=false but high retry backlog.
ops-jordan: customer-impact check: product telemetry shows client retries spiking, a handful of high-value customers seeing request failures and timeouts. CS pinged.
customer-success-anna: notified two customers on support queue, sending templates and ETA.
oncall-alex: mitigation options: (1) manual scale GPUs to buy time, (2) failover autoscale to a CPU-based fallback pool for non-latency-critical customers, (3) fix metrics-adapter backlog.
eng-lee: recommend manual scale + start reroute for certain routes. I'll open a canary routing rule.

```
# scale GPU pool manually
kubectl scale deployment inference-gpu --replicas=12 -n inference
```

sre-maya: doing manual scale now.

```
kubectl scale deployment inference-gpu --replicas=12 -n inference
scaled
```

oncall-alex: scaled to 12. queue drain rate improving but still some throttling.
ml-raj: starting reroute: adding route config to prefer inference-cpu for low-priority customers, leaving premium on GPUs.
eng-lee: pushing config change to traffic router (will debounce 30s): /routing/weights update.
infra-bot: routing update applied, weight change acknowledged by traffic-proxy.

sre-maya: digging into adapter -> prometheus scrape logs show TLS handshake failures to prometheus target at 02:03:45. suspect a cert rotation or network egress policy flapping.
ops-jordan: can you curl metrics endpoint from metrics-adapter pod?
sre-maya: running from pod:

```
kubectl exec -it metrics-adapter-0 -n monitoring -- curl -v https://prometheus.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:9090/metrics
* connection reset by peer
```

sre-maya: connection reset. And k8s events show transient iptables DROP from egress-policy controller during rollout.
ml-raj: that would explain scrape blackout and adapter backlog.
oncall-alex: status now: manual scale holding, reroute applied, partial customer relief. Need root fix for egress policy rollbacks.
eng-lee: ops triggered rollback of the recent NetworkPolicy change 5m ago. rolling back now.
infra-bot: networkpolicy rollback started for monitoring-egress-rule.

sre-maya: after rollback, prometheus scrapes resumed at 02:10:12, adapter backlog clearing.

```
prometheus_scrape_duration_seconds_count{job="scraper"} 12345
```

sre-maya: HPA custom metrics now showing queue metric again.

```
kubectl get --raw "/apis/custom.metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/namespaces/inference/external.metrics" | jq .
# shows queue_length metric=820
```

oncall-alex: HPA reacted, replicas increasing to handle burst.

```
kubectl get hpa -n inference inference-gpu
# now: REPLICAS 12 -> scaling
```

ml-raj: queue draining, error rate down ~85% in 12m. customers reporting improved latencies.
customer-success-anna: sending update to affected customers: we completed mitigation, ongoing follow-up. ETA for RCA tomorrow.
ops-jordan: notes for postmortem: change that caused NetworkPolicy rollout didn't include egress allowlist for prometheus; should have gate on monitoring e2e. Also autoscaler single-point-of-failure: if custom-metrics path fails HPAs stall.
eng-lee: short-term followups: add secondary scrape path, increase metrics-adapter concurrency, and add HPA fallback to internal approx metric (queue gauge via controller) when custom metrics not available.
sre-maya: created incident ticket INF-2026-127 with logs, timeline, and mitigation steps. assigning to eng-lee and infra team for RCA.
oncall-alex: handing off to night oncall ops-jordan at 03:00 UTC. Jordan — please watch for regressions, I'll be reachable for 30m.
ops-jordan: ack. I'll keep a watch window and follow the runbook. :eyes:
incident-bot: Incident INF-2026-127 created and assigned. Priority: P1 (customer-impacting). Handoff at 03:00.
customer-success-anna: keeping CS loop updated. will share postmortem draft once RCA lands.
ml-raj: quick retro note: add a traffic-shed plan for scaling to CPU fallback earlier next time.
eng-lee: action items created: [RCA, NP gating, adapter autoscale thresholds, HPA fallback feature]. I'll add to sprint.
oncall-alex: closing page for now — mitigation in place, monitoring good. Reopen if signs of relapse. :thumbsup:
